ground_coverage.name: Ground Coverage Percentage
ground_coverage.suggestion: Reduce ground coverage for commercial zone.

fsi.name: Floor Space Index (FSI)
fsi.suggestion: Ensure total commercial built-up area does not exceed 3.0 FSI.

building_height.name: Maximum Building Height
building_height.suggestion: Maintain height within commercial limit or upgrade to High-Rise classification.

front_setback.name: Front Setback Distance
front_setback.suggestion: Provide minimum 6m front margin for commercial vehicular access.

stp.name: Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)
stp.suggestion: Install dedicated Sewage Treatment Plant for commercial effluent.
